content:
The homebrew install instructions on https://lean-lang.org/install/manual/ do not use homebrew. The two steps are

  1. Install homebrew (ok, but not usually mentioned)
  2. Install elan through the usual curl/sh method.
    There is nothing about using homebrew to install elan. Should the second step be brew install elan or something like that?
It used to be and then was changed at some point
If brew doesn't work, I would either put a note or delete that section. This is odd, right?
Yeah, either it should tell you to install elan via homebrew, or else it should just ignore homebrew entirely and tell you to use the self-contained installer.
The only way the current thing makes sense is if elan's self contained installer is invoking homebrew covertly. I hope it isn't... let's see... (EDIT: it isn't.)

https://github.com/leanprover-community/leanprover-community.github.io/pull/493 and https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/15276/changes it looks like were PRs that changed this -- I guess I have different taste from Matt and Kim in this regard personally :), I would never want software installed on a computer which wasn't being managed by a package manager if I can ever help it, and I don't think I've noticed elan ever being out of date, homebrew is usually quite good at automatically keeping its packages up to date. Regardless though I think you're right that the current way is probably just unintendedly mixing the two.
Sorry, I don't understand this thread. Do the instructions on that page not result in a working Lean installation?

I think what Jason is highlighting is not that the installation instructions don't work, but that it is a bit confusing that there is a section "Install Homebrew and elan" which asks you to install Homebrew before running a script that installs elan, but the script that installs elan does not itself use brew.

I guess the next section "Install VS Code and the Lean 4 extension" does use brew to install vscode, it's just a bit odd that the user is not told to install brew in that section instead.
Also I admit I did read it as “install elan with homebrew”. I thought it was one option of many for installing Elan. So some of this is on me.
